row.notes: Counts UTF-8 chars from layout+0x1e0 to token+0x10 into token+0x48, looks up the 0x68-stride style record for that char index (falls back to the font named "default"), measures the width of a 0x20 space, then for each tab(9)/space(0x20) byte in token+0x10..+0x18 subtracts it from the remaining width cursor[4] and adds it to cursor[8] and style_state+0x34; a '-' (0x2d) or an exhausted width with wrap mode cursor[2]==3 calls FUN_1443114d0 to start a new line using layout+0x200 as line width. Finally appends a run record (x, width, token, style index, kind 2) to line+0x30 and pushes or overwrites the style in layout+0x2d8. Caller 0x144313230 (Ui_Unk_144310c60) is the per-token layout dispatcher and calls this for token type nibble 1 and 4, so it is the place to hook whitespace width or wrapping.
